day_shape: 50 items: Saudi-Turkey-Pakistan defence pact signed in Mecca/Jeddah triggering Iranian mockery, Iran-Oman Strait of Hormuz understanding reported as near-final, Jerusalem Post cites Trump anger over US munitions shortages, heavy IRGC aerospace/regime messaging cycle, nothing from UK Parliament or OFAC.

threads.label: Saudi-Turkey-Pakistan Mecca defence pact
threads.summary: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan signed a mutual defence pact in Mecca/Jeddah, with Erdogan due to join a trilateral meeting with the Saudi crown prince and Pakistani PM. Iran International reported Iranian officials and clerics mocked the unnamed-threat agreement, promising 'the roar of our missiles' would reach signatories.

threads.label: Iran-Oman Strait of Hormuz understanding
threads.summary: Parliamentary National Security Commission spokesman Qeshqavi said the general framework of an understanding with Oman is set with final text due shortly. Defa Press cited Reuters describing Trump caught between the Oman-brokered deal giving Tehran control of the Strait and escalation risks; Times of Israel framed Iran's Hormuz dominance as becoming a liability.

threads.label: US munitions and internal-fallout claims
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported Trump was angered by disclosures showing dwindling US munitions stockpiles that officials warn could complicate further military action against Iran. IRIB claimed Mossad's chief has sacked two senior officials and that Trump pressured the US Secretary of War over the ammunition-shortage disclosures.

threads.label: Yemen: Ansarallah warnings and Marib blasts
threads.summary: Defa Press reported Ansarallah warned Saudi Arabia that any military movement to or from Yemen would be directly targeted, with political bureau member Hazam al-Asad saying Saudi forces will not be safe. It also reported multiple explosions at the Sahn al-Jinn camp of Saudi-backed forces in Marib province.

threads.label: IRGC Aerospace claims and Iran messaging
threads.summary: Defa Press and IRIB published imagery and commentary claiming IRGC Aerospace Force air defences downed American drones and fighter jets, with redesigned Hajj Qasem-family missiles. IRIB trailed 'first-time details and images' of an American aircraft interception, alongside tributes to martyred commanders Hajizadeh and Bagheri.

events.title_en: Ansarallah warns Saudi Arabia; any military movement in Yemen will be met with response
events.summary_en: Ansarallah warns Saudi Arabia; any military movement in Yemen will be met with response. A Yemeni source told Al-Mayadeen that Sanaa has imposed a new equation on Yemeni territory whereby any military deployment or movement of forces from Saudi Arabia towards Yemen or vice versa will be directly targeted. Sanaa's aim with this equation is to end battlefield combat and dismantle Saudi-affiliated forces whilst preventing movement between provinces. Sanaa advised misled Yemenis through local media to evacuate all bases and not congregate near Saudi officers.

events.title_en: Trump threatens Switzerland too
events.summary_en: The US President, noting that America has a trade deficit of some 39 billion dollars with Switzerland, said: I can eliminate this deficit with one signature. I will ban imports of Swiss watches and goods so that Switzerland transforms from a privileged country to one with serious problems. The US President had previously threatened other European countries, Canada, Greenland and China with imposing heavy tariffs.

events.title_en: Iran's millennia-old civilisation is invincible against threats from newly emerged powers
events.summary_en: Seyyed Mohammad Hosseini, faculty member at Tehran University's Faculty of Theology, referring to recent threats from Donald Trump, emphasised Iran's civilisational superiority, saying: A power of brief standing cannot contend with a civilisation of thousands of years. Iran in negotiations, unlike bitter past experiences such as the Sa'dabad treaties or the JCPOA, does not seek to make concessions; rather, the aim is to recover national rights. Based Quranic verses and divine command regarding non-contention and following leadership, we view unity not as a slogan but as a practical obligation.

events.title_en: 17 violations of Syrian territory by the Zionist regime in the past 48 hours
events.summary_en: Local sources in Syria reported that the Zionist regime has violated Syrian territory 17 times over the past 48 hours. Military violations of Syrian territory by the Zionist regime have increased to unprecedented levels as, following the fall of Bashar al-Assad's government, a power vacuum in border regions and shifts in battlefield balances have created an opportunity for the Zionist regime to intensify violations of Syrian territory and target new areas. Military analysts believe the Zionist regime, exploiting Syrian government inaction, is attempting to expand its influence in the south of the country and establish new equations in the region.

events.title_en: Reuters: Trump caught in a bad dilemma in war against Iran
events.summary_en: Reuters news agency, referring to the swampy impasse the US President has found himself in, wrote: Trump is caught between a temporary agreement under negotiation with Iran and Oman that gives Tehran control of the Strait of Hormuz, or following warnings about severe escalation that risks a longer-term crisis. Analysts say the first option constitutes the greatest concession to Iran since the United States and the Zionist regime attacks on the country on 28 February and legitimises Iran's oversight of this vital oil shipping channel, which the Trump administration had pledged to prevent.

Edward Bigbeder, UNICEF regional director for the Middle East and North Africa, said: A ceasefire that on average takes a child's life each day has failed the children. According to UNICEF, a large portion of Gaza's population now lives in unfavourable conditions. Families have gathered in approximately one-third of Gaza's territory in areas whose infrastructure is damaged and cluttered with rubble and waste.

events.title_en: Hojjat al-Islam Hajj Ali Akbari: living a virtuous life is a public right for all members of society
events.summary_en: Hojjat al-Islam Hajj Ali Akbari: living a virtuous life is a public right for all members of society. The interim Friday prayer leader of Tehran, stating that virtuous living is not merely a religious obligation but a public right for all members of society, said: the enemy's cultural invasion and some neglect and shortcomings domestically have doubled the importance of addressing the matter of virtuous living. Virtuous living is not a mundane issue or purely individual matter. Virtue and modesty have been the special blessings of God and the concern of all prophets and divine saints, and the event of Karbala demonstrated in clear fashion the status of this divine value. The mental, moral, spiritual and social health of society depends on the dominance of a culture of virtue and chastity, and the protection of this value—which is under serious threat from the enemy's cultural invasion and internal irresponsibility—is a duty incumbent upon all.

events.title: A Palestinian terrorist who invaded Israel during the October 7, 2023 onslaught was captured by the IDF earlier this week while working as a truck driver who arrived in the Israeli-held portion of the Gaza Strip to collect goods, according to security sources. The member of Hamas's elite Nukhba Force had requested a permit to deliver private sector goods inside the Strip, and was granted one by the Shin Bet security agency. Upon arriving at the Gazan side of the Kerem Shalom Crossing on Wednesday to collect the goods, Israeli troops apprehended him, the sources say. He was then taken to be questioned by the Shin Bet.

These sources also reported that around six explosions have been heard in Marib so far.

events.title_en: Economic reforms; a difficult decision today for the security of tomorrow's livelihood
events.summary_en: In a recent television interview, the President, whilst announcing an increase in the amount of road tax proportionate to rising prices, stressed that the government will not halt economic reforms. He mentioned reform of the subsidy system, continuation of banking system reform, expansion of renewable energies, tackling rent-seeking and corruption, and movement towards fairer distribution of resources as the main pillars of the government's economic programme. Iran's economy today faces a set of accumulated imbalances, and any government that takes on the responsibility of administering the country is compelled to choose between maintaining the status quo or accepting the cost of reforms.

events.title_en: Anti-sanctions measures of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation
events.summary_en: The twenty-fifth anniversary of the founding of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation has prompted mixed assessments of the organisation's performance. During this time, SCO has remained the subject of criticism due to limited achievements. The Shanghai Cooperation Organisation should be considered a mechanism established in multilateral diplomacy and the best option for an institutional foundation for Eurasian security architecture; provided that a package of concrete proposals is defined to address the concrete problems of member states in the fields of security and development, with the financial sphere being one of the most important pillars. The notion that the idea of establishing a development bank of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation is novel is an incorrect understanding, as this idea preceded the organisation's establishment.

events.title_en: Hadi al-Ameri calls for postponement of retaliatory operations against Saudi Arabia
events.summary_en: The secretary general of Iraq's Badr Organisation called on the country's resistance groups to postpone retaliatory response against Saudi Arabia. Al-Ameri called on resistance groups to delay any reaction to American-Saudi aggression targeting Iraq and overlook the wounds for the higher interests of Iraq. He also pledged to pursue the rights of martyrs and the wounded from American and Saudi aggression through diplomatic channels.

events.title_en: Why did the IRGC's new missiles become costly for America?
events.summary_en: The high knowledge of IRGC Aerospace Force specialists and their ingenuity has created practical innovation during war with America, the result of which is a change in the design of new missiles. Images recently released of IRGC missile strikes show changes in the missiles. The booster from the Hajj Qasem missile family has been used to carry different warheads such as the Khaibar Shaken and Fattah missile warheads so there is no need for redesigning new missiles and incurring related costs, costs are reduced and mass production becomes possible at speed.
